initial: Create one finished educational book illustration for children aged 11–12 in an Indian Class 6 science book. Editorial watercolor and colored pencil with delicate hand-inked contours, matte pigment and subtly textured paper; warm, observant and intelligent, not babyish, not glossy 3D. Two Indian pupils around 11 years old, a girl with brown skin, dark hair in a single long braid, ochre short-sleeved shirt, navy trousers; a boy with brown skin, short dark slightly wavy hair, muted sage short-sleeved shirt, navy trousers. Both have natural realistic child proportions and five fingers per hand. They sit at opposite sides of a simple wooden school desk, in three-quarter view. Girl holds a red-and-slate-blue bar magnet carefully a small distance above a single steel paper clip; boy watches with curiosity holding a pencil over an open notebook. Several loose steel paper clips and a wooden pencil lie on the desk. All objects credible, no floating random objects, no lettering or numbers anywhere. Small natural smiles, no exaggerated cartoon faces. Entire pupils and desk fully within frame, white background vignette, soft edges to the ground shadow, plenty of clean white around the scene. Wide composition 3:2. No page design, text, frames, icons or watermark.

Portrait-ish composition, no decorative sparkles or extra objects.
